_comment: Machine-specific facts for the 1944 (parent set, Europe 000620) checkpoint compatibility validation on MAME 0.289. The server contains none of these. Nothing here concerns Side Fighter objects.

device_without_state_interface.note: has a ROM address space but no state (register) interface and no debug interface

ram.note: accepted by write_memory as plain RAM in the declared map. NOT claimed unused: the mutation test never resumes emulation between the write and the load, so the machine cannot observe the changed value, and restoration is verified by independent read.

pc_loop.note: PC observed around 0x7F4/0x7F6 while running; opcodes-space bytes read from this address (decoded by hand: TST.W $921CC4 ; BEQ back to the TST) - a poll of a flag at 0x921CC4
pc_loop.counter_note: ADDQ.W #1 target in the instructions after the poll (hand-decoded from opcodes space); sampled to see whether the loop keeps being exited
